command: crane manifest gcr.io/distroless/static:latest
notes: Synthetic ~25-line OCI image manifest JSON (schemaVersion 2, mediaType, config, layers array, annotations). Real `crane manifest` emits compact single-line JSON; this fixture uses pretty-printed form so head/tail clipping has visible structure to operate on. Users typically pipe crane output through `tok0 json` for full JSON-aware compression — this rule provides head/tail-only fallback.
